result:
`split_into` now takes a keyword-only `rest=False`, and `python3 ../land.py` printed `LANDED on master`.

With `rest=True`, the items left after the last size come out as one more list, and nothing extra is yielded when none are left. The signature, docstring (with doctests), type stub and three new tests in `tests/test_more.py` are updated. The `-k splitinto` tests pass.

The first `land.py` run hit a CONFLICT because another agent had added a `fillvalue` parameter to `split_into`. I kept both: the signature is now `split_into(iterable, sizes, *, fillvalue=_marker, rest=False)`, and the stub has both keyword arguments. The docstring carries both sections.

I did not run the full test suite or the doctests myself. `land.py` runs the tests as part of landing.
